From fb8543fb863e89baa433b4d716d73395caa1b7f4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Robert Marko <robert.marko@sartura.hr>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2021 00:07:26 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] hwmon: (tps23861) define regmap max register

Define the max register address the device supports.
This allows reading the whole register space via
regmap debugfs, without it only register 0x0 is visible.

This was forgotten in the original driver commit.

Fixes: fff7b8ab2255 ("hwmon: add Texas Instruments TPS23861 driver")
Signed-off-by: Robert Marko <robert.marko@sartura.hr>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210609220728.499879-1-robert.marko@sartura.hr
Signed-off-by: Guenter Roeck <linux@roeck-us.net>

diff --git a/drivers/hwmon/tps23861.c b/drivers/hwmon/tps23861.c
index c2484f15298b..fd0be8883829 100644
--- a/drivers/hwmon/tps23861.c
+++ b/drivers/hwmon/tps23861.c
@@ -117,6 +117,7 @@ struct tps23861_data {
 static struct regmap_config tps23861_regmap_config = {
 	.reg_bits = 8,
 	.val_bits = 8,
+	.max_register = 0x6f,
 };
 
 static int tps23861_read_temp(struct tps23861_data *data, long *val)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/hwmon/tps23861.c`**
- A new line was added to the `tps23861_regmap_config` structure, defining the maximum register address supported by the device. The line added is:
  ```c
  +	.max_register = 0x6f,
  ```

### Relationships
The modification in the `tps23861.c` file addresses a previously overlooked aspect of the driver for the Texas Instruments TPS23861 device. By defining the maximum register address (`0x6f`), the patch enables the ability to read the entire register space through the regmap debugfs interface. This change is crucial for ensuring that all registers are accessible, as previously only register `0x0` was visible. The patch is a fix for the original driver commit that did not include this definition.
